paragraphs: The XF 2.0i is part of the X260 generation of the Jaguar XF, introduced in 2015. It uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine - a turbocharged unit shared across several Ford and Jaguar models of that era. The 2.0i was available in early X260 models as a petrol alternative to the diesel-badged variants.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 Petrol engine fitted to the XF 2.0i - X260 (2015-present).
